submitted.rationale: Of three measurements, the most Fe-rich composition (Fe0.84Sb0.16) had the highest EQE, 0.077%. EQE fell as Sb increased: 0.032% at Fe0.74 and 0.015% at Fe0.48. That trend points to Fe2O3-like material with low Sb content as the best absorber here.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE 0.015%. Near the FeSbO4 composition, but a poor performer
